text: Call supported hosted large language models via Model APIs without deploying them yourself
quote: Use Model APIs to call supported language models without deploying them.

text: Deploy an open-source, fine-tuned, or custom model on dedicated GPU infrastructure with isolated capacity
quote: Deploy an open-source, fine-tuned, or custom model on dedicated GPUs.

text: Fine-tune a supported base model with Loops, or run your own training code with Training Jobs, then serve it
quote: Fine-tune with Loops or run your own training code with Training Jobs.

text: Connect coding agents like Claude Code, Codex CLI, or Pi to Baseten via documented integration guides and Baseten Switch
quote: Connect Claude Code, Codex CLI, or Pi with Baseten Switch.

text: Connect Pi, Droid, or OpenCode directly to the OpenAI-compatible Model APIs endpoint using an API key
quote: Connect Pi, Droid, or OpenCode directly to the OpenAI-compatible Model APIs endpoint with BASETEN_API_KEY

text: Install a Baseten MCP server so a coding agent can manage the workspace and search the docs
quote: Install the Baseten skill and MCP servers so your coding agent can manage your Baseten workspace and search these docs.

text: Structured outputs constrain generation to a specified JSON schema for reliable data extraction
quote: Structured outputs let you generate text that conforms to specific JSON schemas, providing reliable data extraction and controlled text generation.

text: Function/tool calling lets a model select a tool and generate its arguments from a user request
quote: Function calling* (also called *tool calling*) lets a model choose a tool and produce its arguments from a user request.

text: Streaming returns generated tokens one at a time over server-sent events
quote: Streaming sends tokens as they are generated over server-sent events, which suits long generations and UIs where partial output beats a blank wait.

text: Async inference returns a request ID immediately and completes later via webhook or polling, for batch/long-running work
quote: Async inference returns a request ID quickly and completes later through webhook or polling, which suits batch work, long documents

text: Model APIs are billed per token consumed
quote: Model APIs bill by token and enforce request and token rate limits. You can also set a workspace budget and query usage by API key or model.

text: Requests and rate limits are documented and reported via response headers showing remaining quota
quote: x-ratelimit-remaining-requests: Reports how many requests remain before you reach the request rate limit.

text: You can set a workspace spending budget and inspect/attribute usage by API key, user, model, or service tier
quote: You can set a workspace budget, inspect token usage, and attribute costs by API key, user, model, or service tier.

text: Cached prompt tokens are automatically served from KV cache at a discounted rate with no special flags needed
quote: Cached input tokens are prompt tokens served from the KV cache at a discounted rate. Caching is automatic and requires no request flags.

text: Truss packages model code, weights, and dependencies into a model server that behaves identically in dev and prod
quote: Write once, run anywhere: Package model code, weights, and dependencies with a model server that behaves the same in development and production.

text: A single config.yaml plus the truss push CLI command builds and deploys an optimized container with no Dockerfile needed
quote: You write a `config.yaml` that specifies the model, the hardware, and the engine, then `uvx truss push` builds a TensorRT-optimized container and deploys it. No Python code, no Dockerfile, no container management.

text: Deprecated hosted models can be migrated to a dedicated deployment retaining the original weights, with vendor assistance
quote: Migrate to a dedicated deployment with the deprecated model weights. Contact us for assistance.

text: Baseten Switch can install a direct provider path, compare Baseten spend against Anthropic/OpenAI, and route requests to those providers
quote: Switch can also install Pi's direct Baseten provider, compare Baseten spend with estimated costs from Anthropic or OpenAI, and route requests back to those providers.

text: Model APIs support the OpenAI Chat Completions API and (in beta) the Anthropic Messages API for familiar SDK usage
quote: They support the OpenAI Chat Completions API and the Anthropic Messages API in beta, so you can use familiar client SDKs.

text: Basic account rate/usage limits can be raised via email verification, or by upgrading to Pro/Enterprise
quote: To raise a Basic account's limits, request email verification. You can also use that form to move to Pro or Enterprise.

text: Bring your own Axolotl config, TRL script, or custom training loop unchanged in a container; Baseten provisions GPUs and syncs checkpoints
quote: Your Axolotl config, TRL script, or custom loop runs unchanged in a container. Baseten provisions the GPUs, syncs checkpoints as your job saves them, and deploys any checkpoint as a production endpoint.

text: Deploy any synced training checkpoint to a production endpoint with a single CLI command
quote: Deploy any synced checkpoint with one CLI command

text: Baseten's OpenAI-compatible endpoint works with LangChain's ChatOpenAI and with_structured_output by pointing base_url at Baseten
quote: Because Baseten exposes an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, you can use LangChain's `ChatOpenAI` with `with_structured_output` by pointing `base_url` at Baseten

text: Query a model API endpoint to retrieve its effective rate limits programmatically
quote: Check the following headers on successful responses and 429 Too Many Requests errors, or call GET /v1/model_apis/{model_api_name} to retrieve your effective li

text: Use a custom Python model class or Docker server for custom preprocessing, postprocessing, or dependencies
quote: Use a Python model class or a custom Docker server when you need custom preprocessing, postprocessing, dependencies, or server behavior.

text: Deployments run active-active across clusters and clouds, automatically rerouting if a region or provider loses capacity
quote: Deployments run active-active across clusters and clouds. If a region or provider loses capacity, MCM reroutes and reprovisions workloads.

text: Truss supports deploying models from any Python ML framework including transformers, diffusers, PyTorch, TensorFlow, vLLM, SGLang, and TensorRT-LLM
quote: Truss lets you serve models with the Baseten Inference Stack as well as deploy models from any open-source framework: vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, `transformers`, `diffusers`, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and more.
